arguments.prompt:
Create a native pixel-art game animation SOURCE ATLAS of Cousin Calico. EXACT INCARNATION: Freddi Fish4: The Case of the Hogfish Rustlers of Briny Gulch (1999). APPEARANCE: Female yellow catfish Calico, light-blue fins and hair, prominent buck teeth, large ten-gallon rancher hat; preserve swimming catfish body, no legs or purple dress.. EQUIPMENT/ROLE: hogfish-ranch shelter coordination, no firearm. NAMED SOURCE SUPER: Refuge au ranch de Calico. Female yellow/blue catfish with rancher hat; corrects the broad orange/purple placeholder without altering historical source records.

Detailed clean16-bit pixel art, consistent three-quarter side view FACING RIGHT. STRICTLY48 complete independently drawn figures in EIGHT COLUMNS and SIX ROWS, 8x6. Every adjacent FOUR figures is a FOUR-POSE SEQUENCE. Each entire head, body, all native limbs, tail/feathers and complete equipment tips stay inside its own cell. Retain the same anatomy, proportions and outfit in every figure. Leave a CLEAR32-PIXEL OUTER MARGIN and generous transparent gutters between EVERY figure. Make figures slightly smaller to keep real transparent space. No overlapping parts or touching silhouettes. Transparent background, no grid/labels/text/numbers/scenery/ground/cast-shadow.

ROW1 columns1–4 INTRO: approach and ready with four distinct physical postures. Columns5–8 OUTRO: lower tools/hands, turn, depart, settle.
ROW2 columns1–4 ROUND VICTORY: four brief personality-correct acknowledgments. Columns5–8 ROUND LOSS: four disappointed/breathing/steady postures, unharmed.
ROW3 columns1–4 FINISHING PRESENTATION: Four distinct friendly swimming/helpful puzzle gestures: prepare, turn fins, clear helpful pointing/fin/snout gesture in THIRD pose, settle. Complete fish anatomy: fins and tail, NO human arms, legs, feet, weapon or magic bubble. Columns5–8 MATCH VICTORY: four distinct actual celebration postures DIFFERENT from round-win.
ROW4 columns1–4 MATCH LOSS: four unharmed disappointed or crouched/recovering physical postures. Columns5–8 SUPER: Four distinct friendly swimming/helpful puzzle gestures: prepare, turn fins, clear helpful pointing/fin/snout gesture in THIRD pose, settle. Complete fish anatomy: fins and tail, NO human arms, legs, feet, weapon or magic bubble. Four newly drawn poses different from row3.
ROW5 columns1–4 IDLE: four genuinely different breathing/weight/fin/feather/ear positions. Columns5–8 RUN: four true alternating locomotion strides, or swim/bob motion for the actual nonhuman anatomy.
ROW6 columns1–4 ORDINARY ACTION: Four distinct ordinary source-role movements or practical uses of the fixed equipment, preserving the non-offensive role if support. No new attack or offensive effect for a support character. Columns5–8 HIT REACTION: four non-graphic flinch/steady/recover poses, still complete and unharmed.

All48 are DIFFERENT DRAWINGS, not shifted, recoloured, mirrored or copied duplicates. No attack/flash outside the explicit attack groups. No blood, wound, victim, corpse, dismemberment, death or violence against another character. Non-graphic solo acting. These are newly drawn adaptations, not copied official sprite frames.
